title: The First Face
narration: Claire knocked the phone from my hand. He is lying, she said. That surgeon worked for Adam. But the call continued. I did not reconstruct Evelyn to resemble you, he said. I reconstructed you to resemble Evelyn. Claire froze. He sent two surgical records dated the night of the crash. One belonged to Evelyn Ward. The other patient's name was missing. Sophie grabbed the burner phone and ran towards the cemetery gates. Claire chased her. I searched the suitcase. Sewn into its lining was a sealed DNA report. I expected it to prove Claire was Sophie's mother. Instead, the probability beside her name was zero. Beside mine, it read: Biological mother, ninety-nine point nine-eight percent. I remembered Adam placing a newborn into my arms while Claire screamed nearby. Then Sophie said, Daddy says you finally remembered stealing me. Behind me, Claire whispered, She wasn't the baby you stole.
description: The DNA result changes everything—but Claire knows about another stolen baby. #PsychologicalThriller #DomesticThriller #ThrillerSeries #TheFirstFace #HiddenIdentity #DNASecret #FamilyMystery #PlotTwist #FacelessStories #YouTubeShorts
